## Task 1: Basic Vector Practice

### 1) Create two vectors using the `c()` function

```{r}
# create vector with pre measurements using combine function
pre_bp <- c(130, 128, 116, 124, 133, 134, 118, 126, 114, 127, 141, 138, 128, 140, 137, 131, 120, 128, 139, 135)

# create vector with post measurements using combine function
post_bp <- c(114, 98, 113, 99, 107, 116, 113, 111, 119, 117, 101, 119, 130, 122, 106, 106, 124, 102, 117, 113)

```

### 2) Assign names to the vector elements using the `paste()` function 

```{r}

# create names for the 20 subjects using a character vector
names(pre_bp) <- paste("Subject", 1:20, sep = "_")
names(post_bp) <- paste("Subject", 1:20, sep = "_")

pre_bp
post_bp

```
